goal: Document the local current-session pull workflow.
instructions: Write a concise guide explaining how an already-active harness discovers, verifies, acquires, executes, and reports a generic pull task. Include the one-time start permission rule and explain that the active Agent itself performs the work.

constraints: Edit only the documentation page named in target.
Do not start another Agent or model process.
Do not publish, merge, or change repository settings.

acceptance_criteria: The guide gives exact discover, show, acquire, report, and status command examples.
The guide explains that only a newly confirmed start grant allows the current Agent to begin work.
The guide explains how to handle a pending confirmation without automatic retry.
